verdict.rationale: An operating system could plausibly ship built-in AI insights over a user's data, so the axis applies, but the pack has no first-party evidence that Windows itself does this. Copilot is pitched inside Word, Excel and PowerPoint, which are separate apps, not Windows. Paint Cocreator, Studio Effects and Live Captions are generative or media features rather than insights from user data, and Windows AI APIs and the AI Foundry toolkit are developer building blocks.
